senses.example: Han tog ved lære af sine fejl.
senses.example_translation: He learned from his mistakes.

senses.text: to stand up (from sitting or lying)
senses.example: Hun rejser sig op fra stolen og går hen til vinduet.
senses.example_translation: She gets up from her chair and walks to the window.

senses.text: to be travelling (away on a trip)
senses.example: Min søster er ude at rejse i denne uge.
senses.example_translation: My sister is traveling this week.

senses.example: Virksomheden lukkede ned efter mange år med underskud.
senses.example_translation: The company closed down after many years of losses.

senses.example: Hun lukker op for gæsterne, når de ringer på.
senses.example_translation: She opens the door for the guests when they ring the doorbell.

senses.text: to turn a blind eye to
senses.example: Mange lukker øjnene for problemerne i samfundet.
senses.example_translation: Many people turn a blind eye to the problems in society.

senses.example: Det bliver koldt hen imod aften.
senses.example_translation: It will be cold towards evening.

senses.text: to sit down (moving to a spot)
senses.example: Hun sætter sig hen ved vinduet hver morgen.
senses.example_translation: She sits down by the window every morning.

senses.example: Til jobsamtalen skal du sælge dig selv på en god måde.
senses.example_translation: At the job interview, you need to sell yourself in a good way.

senses.example: Mange håndværkere arbejder sort om sommeren.
senses.example_translation: Many craftsmen work off the books in the summer.

senses.example: Min computer gik i sort midt i mødet.
senses.example_translation: My computer crashed in the middle of the meeting.

senses.example: Vi tager på tur til stranden i morgen.
senses.example_translation: We are going on a trip to the beach tomorrow.

senses.example: Dommeren viste ham et rødt kort.
senses.example_translation: The referee showed him a red card.

senses.example: Jeg ser rødt, når nogen lyver for mig.
senses.example_translation: I see red when someone lies to me.

senses.text: to be the cause of (something bad)
senses.example: Den kraftige regn var skyld i oversvømmelsen.
senses.example_translation: The heavy rain was the cause of the flooding.

senses.example: Han passer ind i den nye klasse.
senses.example_translation: He fits into the new class.

senses.text: to be appropriate, to be fitting
senses.example: Det passer sig ikke at tale højt i kirken.
senses.example_translation: It is not appropriate to speak loudly in church.

senses.example: Min jakke hang fast i døren.
senses.example_translation: My jacket was stuck in the door.

senses.example: Computeren hænger fast igen.
senses.example_translation: The computer is stuck again.

senses.example: Du hænger dig i små fejl hele tiden.
senses.example_translation: You get hung up on small mistakes all the time.

senses.example: Røglugten hang ved mit tøj efter festen.
senses.example_translation: The smell of smoke clung to my clothes after the party.

senses.example: Vi stemmer om forslaget i morgen.
senses.example_translation: We will vote on the proposal tomorrow.

senses.example: Hun bliver rød i hovedet, når hun får komplimenter.
senses.example_translation: She blushes when she receives compliments.

senses.example: Han hang med hovedet hele dagen efter nyheden.
senses.example_translation: He moped around all day after the news.

senses.example: Jeg regner efter for at være sikker.
senses.example_translation: I do the math to be sure.

senses.example: Jeg kan mærke på glasset at det er varmt.
senses.example_translation: I can feel from the glass that it is hot.

senses.example: Partiet kom til magten efter et tæt valg.
senses.example_translation: The party came to power after a close election.

senses.example: Han sagde stop efter tre års studier.
senses.example_translation: He quit after three years of study.

senses.example: Jeg forstår beskeden og handler derefter.
senses.example_translation: I understand the message and act accordingly.

senses.example: Hun bærer på en tung kasse.
senses.example_translation: She is carrying a heavy box.

senses.example: Han bærer på en stor sorg.
senses.example_translation: He carries a great sorrow.

senses.example: Vi holder pause klokken tolv.
senses.example_translation: We take a break at twelve.

senses.example: Planen slog fejl, og vi måtte starte forfra.
senses.example_translation: The plan failed, and we had to start over.

senses.example: Vi får besøg af mine forældre i weekenden.
senses.example_translation: We will have a visit from my parents this weekend.

senses.example: Jeg er på besøg hos min ven i dag.
senses.example_translation: I'm visiting my friend today.

senses.example: De tjener på at sælge gamle møbler.
senses.example_translation: They earn money by selling old furniture.

senses.example: Det er slut med gratis kaffe på kontoret.
senses.example_translation: No more free coffee in the office.

senses.example: Bandet giver koncert i parken på lørdag.
senses.example_translation: The band will give a concert in the park on Saturday.

senses.example: Oprørerne tog magten i landet efter krigen.
senses.example_translation: The rebels seized power in the country after the war.

senses.example: Vi gik ud at spise i fredags.
senses.example_translation: We went out to eat on Friday.
